scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:biome && pnpm run lint:eslint && pnpm run lint:boundary
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.contracts.json
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test .test-dist/test/*.test.js && node .test-dist/examples/usage.js
scripts.example: pnpm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node .test-dist/examples/usage.js
